WriteFonts routes the actual ID-ordered font helper through a real fontTable.xml serializer, original namespaces/MIME/relationship and serializer restoration; disposal binds the native document-helper destructor. Complete MainXmlNamespaces preserves native13 prefix order and MC Ignorable value. The actual XmlFilterBase/SwPaM bind consumed native filter/cursor base interfaces; full DocxExportFilter, property/drawing/context initialization, main-text/style/section/numbering orchestration and font embedding remain unported. This is a part-level export owner, not an advertised working DOCX application export.
